name: Kinetic by Windstream
notes: Researched from public gokinetic.com support and legal pages only (no sign-in). The online portal is Go Kinetic (my.gokinetic.com): header link View & Pay Bill, homepage Pay Now, then Make A Payment and Pay Now to submit; Auto Pay is added from the homepage. A $1.46 surcharge applies to all credit card payments (the engine applies it to every card payment, debit included - Kinetic's wording says credit card). Automated phone payments at 800-347-1991 are free; representative-assisted payments may carry a processing fee (amount not published). Internet customers who choose paper bills pay a Paper Invoice Fee (amount not published). AutoPay draws from a checking account or credit card on the date shown on the monthly invoice (exact day not published; family default kept) and can be changed or revoked in Go Kinetic or at 800-347-1991; after two returned payments Kinetic may cancel AutoPay. Month-to-month customers cancel by phone at 1-800-347-1991 with no termination fee, but the last month is not prorated. The sign-in identifier and a pay-without-signing-in option are not described on the pages used, so family defaults are kept. Payment arrangements are not described publicly. Reviewer: Kinetic's payment-options and pay-online pages say online and app payments need a Go Kinetic account and describe no pay-without-signing-in option, so guest_pay is marked unsupported (inferred) with the automated phone line and mail as the offline routes.

cancel_service.note: Kinetic service is cancelled by phone at 1-800-347-1991. Month-to-month customers pay no termination fee, but the last month is billed in full.

guest_pay.note: Paying online needs a Go Kinetic account. Without signing in, pay through the free automated line at 1-800-347-1991 or mail a check.

help.title: Ways to pay your Kinetic bill
paragraphs: Pay and manage your bill in the Go Kinetic portal or app, or set up Auto Pay there. You can also mail your payment to Kinetic, P.O. Box 9001908, Louisville, KY 40290-1908 so it arrives by the due date, or call (800) 347-1991 to pay through the automated system at no charge.

A $1.46 surcharge is added to every credit card payment. A processing fee may apply when a representative takes your payment by phone. Internet customers who choose a paper bill pay a paper bill charge; paperless billing is free.

help.title: Pay your bill online
paragraphs: Log in to Go Kinetic and select Pay Now on your homepage. On Make A Payment, confirm the amount and payment method, then select Pay Now to submit.
To set up Auto Pay instead, select Auto Pay on the homepage, complete the selections and select Add.
steps: Confirm the amount and payment method.

help.title: Auto Pay
paragraphs: Auto Pay moves funds from your checking account or credit card to pay your Kinetic bill on the date shown on your monthly invoice, at no extra charge (a credit card still carries the card surcharge). Enrolling also lets you choose paperless billing.

To change or stop Auto Pay, update your settings in Go Kinetic or call 800-347-1991. Keep your bank or card details current to avoid late or returned payment fees; after two returned payments Kinetic may cancel your Auto Pay.

help.title: Cancel Kinetic service
paragraphs: Month-to-month customers can cancel at any time, without penalty, by calling 1-800-347-1991. You pay for service through the disconnection date, and if you cancel before the end of a billing cycle the last month is charged in full with no proration.

Kinetic does not charge an early termination fee, but customers on a fixed-term service agreement may face penalties under that agreement. Dropping one service from a bundle can change the price of the rest.
